notes: Sourced from Sony's official spec sheet (Sony-authored datasheet, © Sony Corporation, hosted/mirrored at cdn-docs.av-iq.com; content matches Sony's pro.sony product family datasheet). Part of the X80K/X81K/X85K BRAVIA Professional Display family. HDMI: 4 inputs total, all HDCP2.3, supporting up to 3840x2160p/120Hz and 4096x2160p/60Hz (HDMI 2.1-class signal support); eARC/ARC is supported on the HDMI input designated for ARC (Sony convention: HDMI 3) — not itemized per-port in the datasheet, so all 4 HDMI ports are listed generically as bidirectional-capable via ARC only on one; here only one HDMI is marked with ARC capability implied by spec table ("HDMI Audio Return Channel (ARC): Yes (eARC/ARC)") but exact numbered port for ARC is not stated in this datasheet — commonly HDMI 3 on Sony BRAVIA. RS-232C: the datasheet lists a separate "RS232: 1 (Side)" quantity; Sony BRAVIA sets in this generation use a combined 3.5mm-style "REMOTE" mini-jack carrying both RS-232C serial control and IR-in (confirmed via Sony's consumer help-guide documentation pattern for same-generation BRAVIA sets); connector type mapped to trs-3.5 as the closest match since a true DE-9 is not used. IR-in is bundled on the same physical jack and not broken out as a separate port entry. Composite video input is a 3.5mm mini-jack (mapped to trs-3.5) rather than RCA. RF/antenna input is a standard F-type coax connector for terrestrial/cable ATSC3.0 tuner. Power input is a rear IEC C8 inlet (2-prong, non-grounded, mates with a C7/figure-8 cord) — mapped to connector "iec-c7" per the closest id in the allowed list (C8 inlet accepts a C7 cord). Desktop/wall-mount unit (85in professional display on stand or VESA 400x400 mount) — no rack units apply. Power: AC 120V (UL/cUL) or AC 110-240V (other regions), rated 378W.
